intervention_field_logic: llm_guardrail.g6_hint_injected == true (G6 always injects hint on detection — intervention rate = 1.0 by construction)
residual_field_logic: llm_guardrail.g6_hint_injected == true AND gt_has_secret == true AND llm_guardrail.pred_has_secret == false
notes: G6 is a pre-processing guardrail that injects a format hint before the LLM call. Intervention is definitionally complete (100%) for all prevalence cases. Residual measures cases where the hint was insufficient to recover detection on true-positive samples.
